interface.title: MicroGrowth (growthcurves_app) v26.05.11
interface.stage_of_work: Data analysis and quality control of raw plate-reader OD time series, through to figures and export
interface.what_it_is_for: Turn 96-well plate-reader OD600 time series plus a plate map into blank-corrected growth curves with fitted growth parameters (max OD, mu_max, lag, exponential-phase bounds), let the user check and fix fits well by well, compare groups, and export the curated results.

data.note: Uploaded example_data.xlsx (plate reader OD, 694 time points over 0-138.6 h) and example_plate_map.xls (wide-format plate map: strains V9(K317N) and V9(T282A) at concentrations 0-300, triplicate wells, BLANK wells A3/A6/A9). The long-format plate map was not tried.

tree.general: Get trustworthy growth parameters from a multi-well growth experiment and report them
tree.specific: Fit growth curves for every well of a 96-well plate-reader run, curate the fits, compare strains/conditions and export statistics and plots
